# Snowflake specification reference

<!-- Generated by `sst docs` from the engine's registries. Edit the registries, not this file. -->

Every key SST writes into the specifications it sends Snowflake, generated from the tables
SST renders and imports them by (`domain/model/snowflake_spec/`). Each key says what fills it:
an authored key, an `sst_config.yml` setting, a fixed value, or a value SST works out. Its
evidence is the Snowflake page that documents it, or, for a key Snowflake does not document,
the measured behavior recorded in [`snowflake-behavior.md`](../design/snowflake-behavior.md).

A passthrough block merges into what SST writes, mapping into mapping; a key it would
overwrite is `SST-PRS023`. `sst import` keeps what a live specification holds beyond these
keys in passthrough, at whatever depth it sits.

## Agent specification

The `CREATE AGENT ... FROM SPECIFICATION` body each `agent.yml` renders to.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Passthrough

| Authored block | Merges into |
| --- | --- |
| `spec.passthrough` (agent) | the specification's top level |
| `spec.tools.tool_spec_passthrough` (agent) | `tools.[].tool_spec` |
| `spec.tools.passthrough` (agent) | `tool_resources.[]` |
| `spec.passthrough` (cowork_profile) | the specification's top level |

## Not in the specification

What an authored file or setting holds that SST does not write into the specification.

| Key | Where it goes |
| --- | --- |
| `agent:name` | the agent object's name |
| `agent:comment` | the object's COMMENT, set by ALTER AGENT |
| `agent:profile.display_name` | the object's PROFILE, set by ALTER AGENT |
| `agent:profile.avatar` | the object's PROFILE, set by ALTER AGENT |
| `agent:profile.color` | the object's PROFILE, set by ALTER AGENT |
| `agent:deprecated` | SST's own lifecycle marker |
| `agent:meta` | free-form metadata SST never sends |
| `agent:evals.dataset` | the agent's evals, which SST runs itself |
| `agent:evals.config` | the agent's evals, which SST runs itself |
| `agents.database` | where the object is created |
| `agents.schema` | where the object is created |
| `agents.scratch_schema` | where a dev run's object is created |
| `agents.allow_auto_model` | a check on orchestration_model, not a value sent |
| `agents.alias` | the version alias SST commits, not part of the specification |
| `agents.enabled` | whether SST publishes the agent at all |
| `agents.secure` | the object's SECURE flag, set by ALTER AGENT |
| `agents.tags` | object tags, set by ALTER AGENT |
| `cowork_profile:name` | the router agent object's name |
| `cowork_profile:comment` | the object's COMMENT |
| `cowork_profile:display.display_name` | the object's PROFILE, as an agent's profile |
| `cowork_profile:display.avatar` | the object's PROFILE, as an agent's profile |
| `cowork_profile:display.color` | the object's PROFILE, as an agent's profile |
| `cowork_profile:deprecated` | SST's own lifecycle marker |
| `cowork_profile:meta` | free-form metadata SST never sends |
| `cowork_profile:evals.dataset` | the profile's evals, which SST runs itself |
| `cowork_profile:evals.config` | the profile's evals, which SST runs itself |
| `cowork_profiles.database` | where the object is created |
| `cowork_profiles.schema` | where the object is created |
| `cowork_profiles.allow_auto_model` | a check on orchestration_model, not a value sent |
| `cowork_profiles.alias` | the version alias SST commits |
| `cowork_profiles.enabled` | whether SST publishes the profile at all |
| `cowork_profiles.attach` | whether SST attaches the profile to CoWork, a separate statement |
| `cowork_profiles.tags` | object tags, set by ALTER AGENT |
